Find your perfect story with MeChat!

Welcome to the game with a fully new interactive adventure! Live through the stories where you make choices and your choices impact the ending.

EXPLORE and meet dozens of characters who are waiting there for you. Different archetypes, backgrounds and stories. Drama, sci-fi or thriller, what lies ahead? Play to find out!

INTERACT with those you like! Get to know your characters through exciting narrative and fabulous pictures, react with emojis and make choices to impact the story.

UNVEIL hidden secrets of characters you have a strong bond with. You are the main hero and interest in MeChat.
